name: HeicKit
tagline: HeicKit is a free online HEIC to PDF converter that runs entirely in your browser
description: HeicKit is a free online HEIC to PDF converter that runs entirely in your browser. It allows users to convert iPhone photos (HEIC format) into universally compatible PDF documents without any software installation. The tool works through a simple 5-step process: users upload their HEIC files, arrange them in desired order, customize PDF settings (paper size, margins, orientation), preview the result, and download the converted PDF.
